notes.subject: mɔgɔ kelen bɛ a balimakɛ mara
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV vs JPS/Geneva: sɛbɛnni-yɛlɛma fila bɛ yen — 'kelen balimakɛ la maralen' (Leviatan ka bulonw, JPS) walima 'a yɛrɛ ɲɛ dɔgoya' (KJV); an ye JPS ka kumasen ta, sabu Hebrew kɔrɔ tiɲɛ b'o fɛ.

notes.subject: ידבקו / יתלכדו / יתפרדו
notes.rationale: Wale-daɲɛw fila-ni-dalan minnu bɛ fɔ ko u tɛ se ka bɔ ɲɔgɔn na, o misali ka daminɛ ni daɲɛ fitinin ye min bɛ Kumasen ɲɛnajɛ.

translation: Mɔgɔ kelen bɛ a balimakɛ mara; u bɛ nyɔgɔn lamɛn, u tɛ se ka bɔ ɲɔgɔn na.
